t: In front of you is the Odeon on Holloway Road, a multiplex cinema that began life in 1938 as the Gaumont. It was designed by the American architect C. Howard Crane, who worked mainly in Detroit, where he designed the Fox Theatre and Olympia Stadium. It's Grade II listed, and the listing text says its external impact is still greater than almost any other cinema, an example of trans-Atlantic bravura. Take a moment to look up at the front and see what that means.
